anchor.statement: Lemma 5.2. There are radii X a < X − < X + < X b , independent of n, for the following induction. Fix n ≥ 1. For each 1 ≤ j < n, assume that P j is smooth, satisfies Equations (5.2) and (5.5) globally, and obeys (5.12) with n = j. Assume also that these profiles agree with their inner solutions on [0, X − ] and retain the parameter regularity of Lemma 5.1 throughout [0, a 2 ]. For n = 1, there are no lower positive-order hypotheses. Then the inner order-n solution of Lemma 5.1 has a smooth extension to X ≥ 0, | η | ≤ 1, agreeing with it on [0, X − ] and retaining its parameter regularity throughout [0, a 2 ], satisfying Equations (5.2) and (5.5) globally, and obeying m n ( η ) = 0 (| η | ≤ 1), supp X P n ⊂ [0, X + ]. (5.12) Both V n /X and F n /X extend smoothly to X = 0. The stress defined by (5.9) satisfies supp X T 1 ⊂ [X − , X b ], supp X T n ⊂ [X − , X + ] (n ≥ 2), and, for every fixed profile derivative ∂ I , | ∂ I T n (X, η )| ≤ C n,I ζ (X) δ (X) −N n,I (X a < X < X b , | η | ≤ 1). (5.13) Here C n,I , N n,I may depend on the order and derivative; for n ≥ 2 one may take N n,I = 0.

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: exists_step gives each order-n step agreeing with the inner seed for |R| ≤ a, supported in a fixed radius, with βn and Πn from (5.2), (5.5) and mn(η) = 0; for the final coefficients (FinalSlowBase.coefficients is by definition EntranceAlignedBase.modulatedCoefficients = alignedCoefficients) every positive stress is supported in [zeroEnd, activeRight] with activeLeft < zeroEnd, stresses of order n ≥ 2 in [zeroEnd, nominalOuterX], the higher stress quotients by ζ are smooth, and modulated_first_edgeJets bounds the first stress by C ζ δ^(−N) on the outer collar. The per-order bound (5.13) on all of Xa < X < Xb (with N = 0 for n ≥ 2), the identification of X− = zeroEnd and X+ = nominalOuterX < Xb, and the identification of exists_step's generic scheme with the final one are the reviewer's assembly; modulated_weighted_on_actual_scales bounds only the summed tensor, and stressX_weighted_jets is stated for generic tail data.
